title: The Crochet Advent Calendar

panel.heading: Gather these before December
items: Super bulky yarn (Day 6) and bulky yarn (Day 4)
Sport-weight yarn and a 2 mm hook (Day 20)
DK yarn, a 2.5 mm hook and two 6 mm safety eyes (Day 22)
Fiberfill for the little stuffed figures, and plenty of red, white, green and brown worsted

footer: Every pattern and photo belongs to its designer. Each door links to the designer's free pattern page, so the designer gets the visit.

entries.title: Christmas Gift Card Holder
entries.blurb: A festive sleeve for a gift card, finished with a belt buckle. It turns a gift card into something handmade.
notes: Only chain, single crochet and slip stitch
Hang it on the tree for Christmas morning

entries.title: Christmas Ball Ornament
entries.blurb: A classic round bauble. It goes quickly enough that you may want a second one in a different color.
notes: The designer made a second set in jewel tones, so any palette works

entries.title: Mini Mitten Ornament
entries.blurb: A tiny mitten for the tree. Make a pair and join them with a length of yarn.
notes: Same designer as Day 9's mini hat, so the two make a set

entries.title: Peppermint Candy Ornament
entries.blurb: A wrapped red-and-white peppermint. Use it on the tree or as a present topper.
notes: Bulky yarn, 5 mm (H) hook, about 8 yards
About 2 inches across

entries.title: Coffee Mug Cozy
entries.blurb: The first weekend project, and one you'll use every morning. A sleeve for your favorite mug.
notes: Uses the star stitch; the pattern teaches it step by step

entries.title: Mimi Ear Warmer
entries.blurb: A chunky headband worked as one strip, with a chevron point down the middle.
notes: Super bulky yarn
Includes a size chart

entries.title: Tiny Santa Hat
entries.blurb: A little Santa hat with a pompom. Works as an ornament, a keychain or a gift tag.
notes: About 2 inches
Beginner level

entries.title: Christmas Tree Ornament
entries.blurb: A tree to hang on the tree. Add a few beads or French knots as ornaments if you like.

entries.title: Mini Beanie Ornament
entries.blurb: A miniature winter beanie. Hang it next to Day 3's mittens.
notes: Beginner friendly
The pattern has tips on choosing colors

entries.title: Stocking Ornament
entries.blurb: A little stocking with a folded cuff. Use it as an ornament or tuck a small treat inside.
notes: Any yarn size works, so it's a good scrap-buster

entries.title: Gingerbread Man Ornament
entries.blurb: A cookie that won't go stale. White yarn makes the icing and a bit of red makes the buttons.

entries.title: Gingerbread House Ornament
entries.blurb: A weekend project with a home for yesterday's gingerbread man.
notes: The pattern comes with a video

entries.title: Tiny Snowman
entries.blurb: A small stuffed snowman with a carrot nose and a pompom hat.
notes: About 2 inches
4 mm (G) hook
Beginner level

entries.title: Snowflake Coaster
entries.blurb: A snowflake that sits flat under your cocoa mug. Make one per person at the table.
notes: The designer says under 30 minutes, ends woven in

entries.title: Poinsettia Ornament
entries.blurb: The Christmas flower, small enough for a branch. It looks good on a wrapped gift too.
notes: Two petal layers plus a yellow center, sewn together
No unusual techniques

entries.title: Ugly Sweater Ornament
entries.blurb: A tiny holiday sweater. Decorate it as loudly as you like.
notes: Worked top down; sleeves and neckline go on last

entries.title: Christmas Bulb Cover
entries.blurb: A crocheted cover that dresses up a plain plastic bauble and gathers at the top.
notes: Needs a 4-inch round plastic ornament

entries.title: Simple Snowflake
entries.blurb: A small snowflake for the last stretch before Christmas. Hang it on the tree, tie it to a gift, or make a handful and string them into a garland.
notes: Only three rounds
Works in any yarn or thread; the size follows your yarn

entries.title: 1-Hour Christmas Tree
entries.blurb: A standing tree for a shelf or mantel, with a contrast color for the snow.
notes: About 7 inches tall
About 60 yards of worsted in two colors

entries.title: Mini Santa Claus
entries.blurb: The most detailed project in the calendar, saved for a Sunday. A small stuffed Santa to hang or set out.
notes: About 3 inches tall with the hat
Sport-weight yarn and a 2 mm hook
Several small pieces; there's a video tutorial

entries.title: Christmas Wreath Ornament
entries.blurb: A small green wreath with red trim. It looks just as good on a door handle as on the tree.
notes: About 4 inches across
About 24 yards of worsted, 5 mm (H) hook
Easy

entries.title: Reindeer Ornament
entries.blurb: A little stuffed reindeer head with a red nose. Hang it on the tree or tie it onto a gift.
notes: About 2⅝ inches tall
Light (DK) yarn in beige, white and brown, 2.5 mm hook
Two 6 mm safety eyes and a little stuffing
Single crochet throughout, with a video tutorial

entries.title: Flat Candy Cane
entries.blurb: A striped candy cane that works as a gift tag or topper. Add a green ribbon bow.
notes: About 12 yards of worsted in red and white
3.5 mm (E) hook
About 4 inches tall

entries.title: Christmas Star
entries.blurb: The last door. A star for Christmas Eve, for the top of a garland or a gift.
notes: One color of yarn
Hook and yarn size set the star's size
